F12.1.sql: SUM(CASE WHEN skumasterf5.SKU_ID_B1 = 2 THEN fctsalesc2."NET_AMT_DOL_H1" ELSE 0 END)
F12.1.title: filter on the dimension KEY -> fact foreign key
F12.1.solution: If the filtered column is the 'to' key of a relationship fact->dim, rewrite the condition onto the fact's 'from' column (same table, no join).

F12.2.sql: SUM(CASE WHEN skumasterf5.SEGMENT_F7 = 'Software' THEN fctsalesc2."NET_AMT_DOL_H1" ELSE 0 END)
F12.2.title: filter on a dimension ATTRIBUTE
F12.2.solution: Non-key attribute of a related dimension (reachable many-to-one): use the enriched copy <DIM>_<COLUMN> on the fact, or the dimension column through the relationship. Unreachable -> NULL + reason.

F12.3.sql: CASE WHEN ((AVG(CASE WHEN skumasterf5."SKU_ID_B1" = 1 THEN fctsalesc2."LIST_PRICE_U3" END::FLOAT) IS NOT NULL)) AND ((AVG(CASE WHEN skumasterf5."SKU_ID_B1" = 3 THEN fctsalesc2."LIST_PRICE_U3" END::FLOAT) IS NOT NULL)) THEN AVG(CASE WHEN skumasterf5."SKU_ID_B1" = 1 THEN fctsalesc2."LIST_PRICE_U3" END::FLOAT) - AVG(CASE WHEN skumasterf5."SKU_ID_B1" = 3 THEN fctsalesc2."LIST_PRICE_U3" END::FLOAT) ELSE NULL END
F12.3.title: two fixed-key filters subtracted with ISBLANK guards
F12.3.solution: Same key rewrite inside each CALCULATE; NOT ISBLANK(x) -> x IS NOT NULL; IF without else -> NULL.

F13.1.title: USERELATIONSHIP on the inactive date path
F13.1.solution: Emit each inactive relationship as an alias of the dimension named '<Dim> <FK column>' (here calendar_ship_date) joined on that FK; USERELATIONSHIP(...) switches the filter to that alias.

F13.2.title: USERELATIONSHIP with a row count
F13.2.solution: Same alias rule; counts use COUNT(CASE WHEN ... THEN key END) with no ELSE.
